Course.Title: Structured Programming
Course.Rationale: This course is designed to introduce students to the algorithms' way of thinking and problem-solving by computers. Students learn the fundamental principles of structured programming. Typical characteristics and mechanisms of structured programming languages are introduced, and students are introduced to the design and development of programs written in this language. Programming languages in use in the software business. Lessons are completed by practices where theoretical knowledge is applied in a cooperative software environment.

CourseObjectives.Objective: Make students familiar with basic software design principles, good programming style, structured approach to program design, development, testing, and documentation

StudentLearningOutcomes.Outcome: After successful completion of this course, students should be able to:
Familiarize with algorithms and step into algorithmic program in its structured way
Implement algorithms into code and describe programming methodologies

CourseDescription.Content: C, Keywords, History and Features, Basic Structure of Program and Hello World Program, C Program Execution Process
Formatted and Unformatted, Basic Types, Operator and Expression, Bitwise, Relational Operators
One and Multi-dimensional arrays, Pointers and Strings

Course.Title: Structured Programming Laboratory
Course.Rationale: This lab course is designed to provide students with hands-on experience on basic programming using C. Programming language is used as the base in this course. Theoretical lessons are complemented by this practical where students' theoretical knowledge is applied to cooperative software development.

CourseObjectives.Objective: To make students familiar with the practical experience of basic programming principles, good programming style, and structured programming

LabOutcomes.Outcome: Familiarize students with algorithmic programming steps
Make students implement the theory they learn in C

HardwareSoftwareRequirements.HW: Core i5, 2.4 GHz, 4 GB RAM, 500 MB disk space

Course.Title: Electrical Circuits
Course.Rationale: This course gives an introduction to electrical circuit theory. It provides a foundation for understanding and designing simple electric and magnetic circuits built using basic electrical circuit elements.

CourseObjectives.Objective: To introduce the basics of electrical circuit analysis and design

CourseDescription.Content: Basic principles of voltage sources, current sources, and Ohm's law.
AC series and parallel circuits, voltage, current, and impedance calculations.

Book.Title: Electric Machines
Book.Author: D. P. Kothari, I. J. Nagrath
